children: Patriot Mobile filed for an initial public offering.
The company did not say how many shares it intends to list, or at what price, according to a Friday filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The connectivity company said in its filing that it seeks to serve customers who share Christian and conservative values.
It reported a loss of $4.6 million on $53.4 million in revenue for the first half of this year.
The company will remain majority controlled by an investor named Bryan Bradford following the IPO, according to the filing.
It applied to list shares on Nasdaq under the symbol PTRT.
